mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warn_event_timeline (event_id, node_type, actor_type, actor_id, actor_name, action, detail, occur_time, create_time) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{nodeType}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{actorName}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{occurTime}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, node_type AS nodeType, actor_type AS actorType, actor_id AS actorId, actor_name AS actorName, action, detail, occur_time AS occurTime FROM warn_event_timeline WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY occur_time, id
